full_details: In the morning the sheet for Susanna was still blank. She is still eleven. The twenty-sixth is Monday. The thimble is on the road. You did not start the letter. At two you were in the Shrew, an old man of the house, not the lover. You were off before the end, and you did not go on again. At home the loaf was a penny, a finger and a half short. Board was threepence. You told them the letter can wait until its own day. The king's three sentences stayed as Wednesday left them.
one_sentence: You named Susanna's day, played an old man in the Shrew, and came off before the end.
title: An old man in the Shrew, and Susanna's day
